title: Dining Plan Away Credit for Planned Absences from the Community
content:
A Dining Plan resident who will be away from the community for at least 7 consecutive days may register the absence and receive a plan fee credit. The desk applies the rule as follows.

## The rule

1. **Length of absence.** The absence must run at least 7 consecutive days.
2. **Registering in time.** The absence must be registered no later than 3 days before the first day away. The notice is counted in calendar days back from the first day away, so the last day to register is that day minus 3 calendar days, inclusive. The first day away is the one recorded on the plan's absence registration; the date compared with it is the date the absence is registered.
3. **The credit.** After the absence the credit is 100 percent of the daily plan fee - the monthly plan fee divided by the days in that month - for each day away up to 30 days. Days away are counted from the first day away to the last day away, both inclusive. There is one away credit per absence, referencing the month's plan fee charge, and the credit amount is rounded to the cent half up; the amount rounded is the credit for the absence as a whole, in which the daily plan fee enters unrounded.
4. **Meal credits.** The month's meal credits are not reduced, and they still expire under the monthly cycle.
5. **Late registration.** An absence not registered in time earns no credit, and each registered absence earns one away credit.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| First day away | Registered on | Days before the first day away | In time |
|---|---|---|---|
| The 15th | The 11th | 4 | Yes |
| The 15th | The 12th | 3 (the last day to register) | Yes |
| The 15th | The 13th | 2 | No - no credit |

| Days away (first to last, inclusive) | At least 7 consecutive days |
|---|---|
| The 3rd to the 9th: 7 days | Yes |
| The 3rd to the 8th: 6 days | No |

## Credit worked through (hypothetical)

A resident on the Dining 30 Meal Plan, monthly plan fee 479.00 US dollars, registers in time and is away from the 3rd to the 12th of a 31-day month: 10 days, within the 30-day limit. The credit is 100 percent of 479.00 divided by 31 for each of the 10 days, which is 154.5161..., rounded half up once, to 154.52 US dollars. The resident's meal credits for the month stay as they are.

For an absence of 40 days, only 30 days are credited.
